title: coland interop: facade wire is Arkret canonical JSON under /_arkret/open/mimi, not application/mimi-protocol TLS-PL
description:
Side: coland.

The facade carries Arkret canonical JSON, not application/mimi-protocol (TLS presentation language, protocol-07 §5 intro). Examples: key-material takes arkret_models_crypto::KeyPackagesClaimRequestBody (claim_request_id, target_account_id, service_binding, requester_authorization...), and identifiers/query takes {identifiers:[{kind, identifier_commitment:"sha256:..."}]}. Rooms are addressed by Arkret strand_id in the path plus a MIMI-Room-URI header. Every /_arkret/* request also needs an Arkret-Operation header (otherwise 400 operation_selector_required), including the GET provider-directory twin. The -07 paths (/v1/keyMaterial/{targetUser} and so on) return 404.
So even with signatures solved, mimid's TLS-PL KeyMaterialRequest etc. would not parse. A bridge would need a full JSON<->TLS-PL translation, not a profile tweak.
Code: crates/http/src/routing/interop/mimi.rs (router), handlers.rs; arkret-rust-sdk crates/models-collaboration/src/mimi_operations.rs.
